question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cramped
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cramped"** means something that is uncomfortably small or restricted in space. (संकीर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The studio apartment was so cramped that there was hardly any room to move.
 
 
 
• **"Spacious"** refers to having ample space; roomy. (विशाल)
 
 
• **Example:** The new office is spacious and has plenty of room for all the employees.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Cramped'** is **'Spacious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crammed** (ठसाठस भरा): Completely filled to the point of overflowing.

 
 
• **Example:** The train was crammed with passengers during the rush hour.
 
 
 
• **Filthy** (गंदा): Disgustingly dirty.
 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen was filthy after the party.
 
 
 
• **Tight** (कसकर): Fixed, fastened, or closed firmly.
 
 
• **Example:** The lid was so tight that I couldn't open the jar.
